analysis: The method getTopLevelType first checks if mimeType is null, returning null. Then it checks if indexOf('/') returns -1, returning null. Thus the substring is only called when mimeType is non-null and contains a '/' character. The indexOfSlash is the index of the first '/', which is between 0 and mimeType.length()-1 inclusive. The substring call uses beginIndex=0 and endIndex=indexOfSlash. Since beginIndex=0 is non-negative, endIndex is less than or equal to mimeType.length()-1 (so less than length), and beginIndex (0) is not greater than endIndex (since endIndex >=0), all conditions for IndexOutOfBoundsException are avoided.
remark: No exceptions are not avoided because the prior checks ensure the substring call is only made on a non-null string that contains a '/', and the range [0, indexOfSlash) is always valid.
